stories.title: Anthropic's Claude Fable 5.2 不只是產生影像，它是在畫畫 / Anthropic's Claude Fable 5.2 doesn't generate images, it paints them

sources.title: Anthropic's Claude Fable 5.2 不只是產生影像，它是在畫畫 / Anthropic's Claude Fable 5.2 doesn't generate images, it paints them
sources.title_zh: Anthropic's Claude Fable 5.2 不只是產生影像，它是在畫畫
sources.title_en: Anthropic's Claude Fable 5.2 doesn't generate images, it paints them
sources.title_original: Anthropic's Claude Fable 5.2 doesn't generate images, it paints them
sources.summary: Anthropic's Claude Fable 5.2 doesn't generate images the way other AI models do. Instead of computing pixels, the language model writes Python code that places hundreds of thousands of simulated brushstrokes on a virtual canvas, complete with bristle texture and paint application. A single photorealistic parking garage scene took roughly 700,000 strokes, according to Anthropic employee Jake Eaton. The article Anthropic's Claude Fable 5.2 doesn't generate images, it paints them appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: Anthropic's Claude Fable 5.2 的運作方式與其他 AI 模型不同，它不會產生影像。這個語言模型不會去計算像素，而是編寫 Python 程式碼，在虛擬畫布上配置數十萬個模擬筆觸，並具備刷毛質感與顏料塗布效果。Anthropic 員工 Jake Eaton 表示，單單一個逼真的停車場場景就大約花費了 700,000 個筆觸。

stories.title: 據報導，與黃仁勳前情人有關的公司居中斡旋了近 120 億美元的輝達中國晶片訂單 / Firm linked to Jensen Huang's ex-lover reportedly brokered nearly $12 billion in Nvidia chip orders for China

sources.title: 據報導，與黃仁勳前情人有關的公司居中斡旋了近 120 億美元的輝達中國晶片訂單 / Firm linked to Jensen Huang's ex-lover reportedly brokered nearly $12 billion in Nvidia chip orders for China
sources.title_zh: 據報導，與黃仁勳前情人有關的公司居中斡旋了近 120 億美元的輝達中國晶片訂單
sources.title_en: Firm linked to Jensen Huang's ex-lover reportedly brokered nearly $12 billion in Nvidia chip orders for China
sources.title_original: Firm linked to Jensen Huang's ex-lover reportedly brokered nearly $12 billion in Nvidia chip orders for China
sources.summary: Megaspeed, the firm owned by ousted Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang's former lover Alice Huang, arranged nearly $12 billion in Nvidia chip orders for Chinese companies between 2024 and 2025, according to the WSJ. Short seller Culper Research estimates Nvidia's actual China revenue share exceeds 20 percent, far above the officially reported 7 percent. The article Firm linked to Jensen Huang's ex-lover reportedly brokered nearly $12 billion in Nvidia chip orders for China appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: 根據《華爾街日報》報導，由輝達遭拔除執行長黃仁勳的前情人愛麗絲・黃（Alice Huang）所擁有的公司 Megaspeed，在 2024 年至 2025 年間為中國企業安排了近 120 億美元的輝達晶片訂單。放空機構 Culper Research 估計，輝達在中國的實際營收佔比超過 20%，遠高於官方報導的 7%。

sources.title_zh: 美團發布了一款從未使用過輝達 GPU 的 1.6 兆參數代理模型
sources.title_en: Meituan releases a 1.6-trillion-parameter agent model that never touched an Nvidia GPU
sources.title_original: Meituan releases a 1.6-trillion-parameter agent model that never touched an Nvidia GPU
sources.summary: Meituan has released the weights for LongCat-2.5, a 1.6-trillion-parameter model built for AI agents and trained entirely on Chinese hardware. sources.title: 澳洲央行發現人工智慧首當其衝影響年輕員工，特別是在軟體與客戶服務領域 / Australia's central bank finds AI hitting young workers first, especially in software and customer service
sources.title_zh: 澳洲央行發現人工智慧首當其衝影響年輕員工，特別是在軟體與客戶服務領域
sources.title_en: Australia's central bank finds AI hitting young workers first, especially in software and customer service
sources.title_original: Australia's central bank finds AI hitting young workers first, especially in software and customer service
sources.summary: Australia's central bank sees early signs that AI is hitting young entry-level workers in highly exposed jobs like software development and customer service. Since ChatGPT launched, job postings and employment among 15- to 24-year-olds in those fields have dropped more sharply than among older workers. Author Mike Major cautions against jumping to conclusions, however, noting that business cycle shifts and remote work trends could also explain the numbers. The article Australia's central bank finds AI hitting young workers first, especially in software and customer service appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: 澳洲央行發現早期跡象顯示，人工智慧正在衝擊高度曝險職位（如軟體開發和客戶服務）的年輕入門員工。自 ChatGPT 推出以來，這些領域中 15 至 24 歲族群的職缺與就業率下降幅度，比年長員工更為劇烈。不過，作家麥克・梅傑（Mike Major）警告切勿妄下定論，並指出景氣迴圈轉變和遠距工作趨勢也可能是這些資料的原因。

sources.summary: 科技博主Mark Gurman披露，蘋果計劃於2027年6月WWDC發佈首款AI智能眼鏡，預計2027年底前上市，內部代號N50，硬件設計已基本定型。該眼鏡比Meta二代Ray-Ban更纖薄，攝像頭集成在鏡框內無凸起，提供多種款式配色，並優化音質、傳感器和佩戴體驗。功能上首代產品信息未完整披露。

sources.title_zh: 豆包 App 上線“找店”:商家批量標註地圖，團購下單與一鍵導航在對話內閉環
sources.title_original: 豆包 App 上線“找店”:商家批量標註地圖，團購下單與一鍵導航在對話內閉環
sources.summary: 據《讀佳》報道，字節跳動豆包App上線“找店”功能：商家批量標註在地圖上，點門店圖標可直達商家頁看團購套餐並下單，也可一鍵導航，將找店、比價、下單、出行收攏於同一對話頁。繼“出行用豆包”超級入口打通打車、導航與酒店預訂後，這是豆包本地生活場景的再次落地，也不同於此前AI推薦餐廳僅返回文字清單。

sources.summary: 11月14日報道，馬斯克等科技高管聯名簽署請願書，呼籲英偉達董事會恢復黃仁勳CEO職務。截至週六下午，已有超11.5萬人簽名，包括5965名現任員工、1108名前員工和63063名股東。支持者還有Replit、Epic Games、Y Combinator的CEO等。請願書提及黃仁勳在缺乏正當程序情況下的問題。

sources.summary: Unsurprisingly, following the scandal involving now-former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang and a suspected Chinese spy, Congress is looking to further restrict exports of AI chips. Both Democrats and Republicans have voiced support for various measures and bills that would tighten rules and have demanded that Huang and other Nvidia leaders testify before Congress. Senate Minority […]
sources.summary_zh: 毫不意外地，在涉及現已卸任的輝達執行長黃仁勳與疑似中國間諜的醜聞之後，國會正尋求進一步限制AI晶片的出口。民主黨與共和黨雙方都表達了對各種旨在收緊規則的措施與法案的支持，並要求黃仁勳和其他輝達領導層前往國會作證。參議院少數黨［…］

sources.summary: Bland has released Tofu-1, a full-duplex speech-to-speech model for noisy, high-stakes phone calls. The post Bland Launches Tofu-1, a Full-Duplex Speech-to-Speech Model for Calls appeared first on MarkTechPost .

sources.summary: Release: datasette-agent 0.6a0 Accumulated small fixes for Datasette Agent, my agent plugin for Datasette that lets you ask questions about your data. Most notably, it now adds an agent prompt directly to the Datasette homepage, with support for hash-mentions of tables and queries: Tags: datasette-agent , llm , datasette , llms , ai , generative-ai
sources.summary_zh: 發布：datasette-agent 0.6a0 累積針對 Datasette Agent 的小型修正。這是我的 Datasette 代理程式外掛程式，可讓您針對您的資料提出問題。最值得注意的是，它現在直接在 Datasette 首頁新增了一個代理程式提示詞，並支援以井號提及（hash-mentions）表格與查詢：標籤：datasette-agent , llm , datasette , llms , ai , generative-ai

events.news_summary: Anthropic的Claude Fable 5.2透過撰寫Python程式碼繪製畫筆筆觸來生成圖像，而非計算像素。

sources.title: Anthropic's Claude Fable 5.2 不只是產生影像，它是在畫畫 / Anthropic's Claude Fable 5.2 doesn't generate images, it paints them
sources.title_zh: Anthropic's Claude Fable 5.2 不只是產生影像，它是在畫畫
sources.title_en: Anthropic's Claude Fable 5.2 doesn't generate images, it paints them
sources.title_original: Anthropic's Claude Fable 5.2 doesn't generate images, it paints them
sources.summary: Anthropic's Claude Fable 5.2 doesn't generate images the way other AI models do. Instead of computing pixels, the language model writes Python code that places hundreds of thousands of simulated brushstrokes on a virtual canvas, complete with bristle texture and paint application. A single photorealistic parking garage scene took roughly 700,000 strokes, according to Anthropic employee Jake Eaton. The article Anthropic's Claude Fable 5.2 doesn't generate images, it paints them appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: Anthropic's Claude Fable 5.2 的運作方式與其他 AI 模型不同，它不會產生影像。這個語言模型不會去計算像素，而是編寫 Python 程式碼，在虛擬畫布上配置數十萬個模擬筆觸，並具備刷毛質感與顏料塗布效果。Anthropic 員工 Jake Eaton 表示，單單一個逼真的停車場場景就大約花費了 700,000 個筆觸。

sources.title: 美團發布了一款從未使用過輝達 GPU 的 1.6 兆參數代理模型 / Meituan releases a 1.6-trillion-parameter agent model that never touched an Nvidia GPU
sources.title_zh: 美團發布了一款從未使用過輝達 GPU 的 1.6 兆參數代理模型
sources.title_en: Meituan releases a 1.6-trillion-parameter agent model that never touched an Nvidia GPU
sources.title_original: Meituan releases a 1.6-trillion-parameter agent model that never touched an Nvidia GPU
sources.summary: Meituan has released the weights for LongCat-2.5, a 1.6-trillion-parameter model built for AI agents and trained entirely on Chinese hardware. On Terminal Bench, it scores 88.4 points, landing just behind Claude Opus 5. The sample deployment runs on 194 Huawei Ascend chips, and Meituan makes no mention of Nvidia GPUs. The article Meituan releases a 1.6-trillion-parameter agent model that never touched an Nvidia GPU appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: 美團已發布 LongCat-2.5 的權重，這是一款專為 AI 代理打造、擁有 1.6 兆參數的模型，且完全在中國硬體上訓練。在 Terminal Bench 上，它獲得了 88.4 分，僅落後於 Claude Opus 5。範例部署運行在 194 個 華為 昇騰（Ascend）晶片上，且美團未提及輝達（Nvidia）GPU。

sources.title: 谷歌Gemini接入Google Wallet，美國用戶可使用AI分析個人財務
sources.title_zh: GoogleGemini接入Google Wallet，美國用戶可使用AI分析個人財務
sources.title_original: 谷歌Gemini接入Google Wallet，美國用戶可使用AI分析個人財務
sources.summary: 谷歌宣佈，美國 Gemini 用戶現可通過 Personal Intelligence 連接 Google Wallet，用 AI 分析個人財務狀況並獲取個性化理財建議。用戶還能經 Plaid 關聯銀行賬戶和信用卡；該平臺也爲 ChatGPT 提供金融賬戶集成。連接後，Gemini 可分析交易記錄，回答日常支出、預算、訂閱等問題。

events.news_summary: 據Mark Gurman披露，蘋果首款AI眼鏡代號N50，計劃2027年WWDC發佈，年底前上市。

sources.title: 蘋果首款AI眼鏡計劃2027年WWDC亮相，年底前上市
sources.title_zh: 蘋果首款AI眼鏡計劃2027年WWDC亮相，年底前上市
sources.title_original: 蘋果首款AI眼鏡計劃2027年WWDC亮相，年底前上市
sources.summary: 科技博主Mark Gurman披露，蘋果計劃於2027年6月WWDC發佈首款AI智能眼鏡，預計2027年底前上市，內部代號N50，硬件設計已基本定型。該眼鏡比Meta二代Ray-Ban更纖薄，攝像頭集成在鏡框內無凸起，提供多種款式配色，並優化音質、傳感器和佩戴體驗。功能上首代產品信息未完整披露。

sources.title: 在輝達間諜醜聞後，國會希望收緊AI晶片出口規則 / Congress wants to tighten export rules on AI chips after Nvidia spy scandal

sources.title_en: Congress wants to tighten export rules on AI chips after Nvidia spy scandal
sources.title_original: Congress wants to tighten export rules on AI chips after Nvidia spy scandal
sources.summary: Unsurprisingly, following the scandal involving now-former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang and a suspected Chinese spy, Congress is looking to further restrict exports of AI chips. Both Democrats and Republicans have voiced support for various measures and bills that would tighten rules and have demanded that Huang and other Nvidia leaders testify before Congress. Senate Minority […]
sources.summary_zh: 毫不意外地，在涉及現已卸任的輝達執行長黃仁勳與疑似中國間諜的醜聞之後，國會正尋求進一步限制AI晶片的出口。民主黨與共和黨雙方都表達了對各種旨在收緊規則的措施與法案的支持，並要求黃仁勳和其他輝達領導層前往國會作證。參議院少數黨［…］

sources.summary: Bland has released Tofu-1, a full-duplex speech-to-speech model for noisy, high-stakes phone calls. sources.title: 據報導，與黃仁勳前情人有關的公司居中斡旋了近 120 億美元的輝達中國晶片訂單 / Firm linked to Jensen Huang's ex-lover reportedly brokered nearly $12 billion in Nvidia chip orders for China
sources.title_zh: 據報導，與黃仁勳前情人有關的公司居中斡旋了近 120 億美元的輝達中國晶片訂單
sources.title_en: Firm linked to Jensen Huang's ex-lover reportedly brokered nearly $12 billion in Nvidia chip orders for China
sources.title_original: Firm linked to Jensen Huang's ex-lover reportedly brokered nearly $12 billion in Nvidia chip orders for China
sources.summary: Megaspeed, the firm owned by ousted Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang's former lover Alice Huang, arranged nearly $12 billion in Nvidia chip orders for Chinese companies between 2024 and 2025, according to the WSJ. Short seller Culper Research estimates Nvidia's actual China revenue share exceeds 20 percent, far above the officially reported 7 percent. The article Firm linked to Jensen Huang's ex-lover reportedly brokered nearly $12 billion in Nvidia chip orders for China appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: 根據《華爾街日報》報導，由輝達遭拔除執行長黃仁勳的前情人愛麗絲・黃（Alice Huang）所擁有的公司 Megaspeed，在 2024 年至 2025 年間為中國企業安排了近 120 億美元的輝達晶片訂單。放空機構 Culper Research 估計，輝達在中國的實際營收佔比超過 20%，遠高於官方報導的 7%。

sources.summary: 華爲雲將於11月16日14:00-15:30舉辦線上發佈會，正式發佈首款昇騰原生具身世界模型CloudRoboWM1.2，推動具身智能從實驗室研發走向千行百業規模化落地。華爲雲具身產品線總裁、具身智能Lab主任吳小東將發佈該模型；首席模型專家劉流解讀其架構與核心能力；產業生態負責人丁志彬亦在議程中。

sources.title: 澳洲央行發現人工智慧首當其衝影響年輕員工，特別是在軟體與客戶服務領域 / Australia's central bank finds AI hitting young workers first, especially in software and customer service
sources.title_zh: 澳洲央行發現人工智慧首當其衝影響年輕員工，特別是在軟體與客戶服務領域
sources.title_en: Australia's central bank finds AI hitting young workers first, especially in software and customer service
sources.title_original: Australia's central bank finds AI hitting young workers first, especially in software and customer service
sources.summary: Australia's central bank sees early signs that AI is hitting young entry-level workers in highly exposed jobs like software development and customer service. Since ChatGPT launched, job postings and employment among 15- to 24-year-olds in those fields have dropped more sharply than among older workers. Author Mike Major cautions against jumping to conclusions, however, noting that business cycle shifts and remote work trends could also explain the numbers. The article Australia's central bank finds AI hitting young workers first, especially in software and customer service appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: 澳洲央行發現早期跡象顯示，人工智慧正在衝擊高度曝險職位（如軟體開發和客戶服務）的年輕入門員工。自 ChatGPT 推出以來，這些領域中 15 至 24 歲族群的職缺與就業率下降幅度，比年長員工更為劇烈。不過，作家麥克・梅傑（Mike Major）警告切勿妄下定論，並指出景氣迴圈轉變和遠距工作趨勢也可能是這些資料的原因。

sources.title: 豆包 App 上線“找店”:商家批量標註地圖，團購下單與一鍵導航在對話內閉環
sources.title_zh: 豆包 App 上線“找店”:商家批量標註地圖，團購下單與一鍵導航在對話內閉環
sources.title_original: 豆包 App 上線“找店”:商家批量標註地圖，團購下單與一鍵導航在對話內閉環
sources.summary: 據《讀佳》報道，字節跳動豆包App上線“找店”功能：商家批量標註在地圖上，點門店圖標可直達商家頁看團購套餐並下單，也可一鍵導航，將找店、比價、下單、出行收攏於同一對話頁。繼“出行用豆包”超級入口打通打車、導航與酒店預訂後，這是豆包本地生活場景的再次落地，也不同於此前AI推薦餐廳僅返回文字清單。

In an announcement on Wednesday, Google highlights Carbon's top spot on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index (v5.0) benchmark, with Claude Opus 5.5 and GPT-6 Astra trailing behind. featured_primary_item.summary: Meituan has released the weights for LongCat-2.5, a 1.6-trillion-parameter model built for AI agents and trained entirely on Chinese hardware. On Terminal Bench, it scores 88.4 points, landing just behind Claude Opus 5. The sample deployment runs on 194 Huawei Ascend chips, and Meituan makes no mention of Nvidia GPUs.
